**Date:** November 14, 2025

**Issue:** CRITICAL-2 - Novel entities → mortality integration
**Historian:** Auto-generated by wiki-documentation-updater agent

---

## Overview

This commit adds **baseline ongoing mortality from chemical pollution** to the novel entities system. Previously, chemical pollution only contributed mortality during crisis events (reproductive crisis, bioaccumulation collapse, chronic disease epidemic), which never triggered in typical 10-year simulations because they were calibrated for 50-year timescales.

**Key Change:** Added continuous baseline mortality that scales with pollution load, calibrated to match real-world data (1.8M deaths/year at 2025 baseline).
